{{Quote|But Hagamoor Three is part of the Getelles holdings, correct? It's a moon orbiting Antemeridias?|[[Jagged Fel]]|<ref name="Apocalypse" />}}
'''Hagamoor 3''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Antemeridias]] located inside the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant's]] territories by [[44 ABY]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], it served as the home for the [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] who had created the [[nanovirus]] strand that targeted the [[Clan Fett|family]] of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. Also, the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[The Ones/Legends|entity]] [[Abeloth]], who had consumed and taken on the body of Imperial [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Lydea Pagorski]], traveled to the Remnant to lead the campaign of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]] against [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]] in the first [[Imperial Election of 44 ABY|Imperial election]]. Abeloth based herself on Hagamoor 3, where she was tracked down by former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Tahiri Veila]] at Fel's behest. Veila met with Fett, who had tracked down the scientists before being trapped by Abeloth, and the two assisted each other in their objectives&mdash;Fett's to learn more about the nanovirus and see if there was anything he could do to reverse it, and Veila's to destroy Abeloth's body in the form of Pagorski.
